README.md	| Run locally | `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=local DB_USERNAME=<owner> SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=<password> ATM_DIRECTORY_SEED_ENABLED=true ./gradlew bootRun` (PostgreSQL `db_of_atm_directory_local`; locally one owner role may run Flyway and the service). The startup TLS assertion is on by default (`fintechbankx.tls.enforce`: DB_URL and FLYWAY_URL `sslmode=verify-full` with the RDS CA bundle); only the `local` profile and the test resources switch it off, and the chart refuses both |	a usage line: the password is the <password> placeholder, passed through the environment
